metas.name: Don't Look Back in Anger
metas.description: Experience the meteoric rise of Oasis through rare footage and untold stories as the band reunites for Oasis Live '25, chronicling their journey from Manchester streets to global rock stardom.

metas.name: The Last First: Winter K2
metas.description: K2's first winter ascent claimed 5 lives, revealing modern alpinism's struggles with commercialization, social media impact, and conflicts between marginalized climbers and traditional elites.

metas.name: The Widower: 'Til Death Do Us Part
metas.description: A journalist and a detective uncover the truth about a killer whose charm masked a trail of failed marriages and suspicious deaths.

metas.name: Jackass: Best and Last
metas.description: Follows the Jackass crew as they perform their final series of dangerous stunts and pranks, marking the end of the franchise.

metas.name: Schumacher '94: The Birth of a Legend
metas.description: Follows 25-year-old Michael Schumacher's breakthrough 1994 Formula 1 season, featuring his first Grand Prix win in Brazil and the dramatic events of one of F1's most exciting racing seasons, including Ayrton Senna's accident.

metas.name: A Toxic Love Story
metas.description: A string of threatening e-mails escalates into a revenge plot involving a newly-married US Marshal and his ex-girlfriend.

metas.name: Shipwrecked: Nightmare at Sea
metas.description: Exclusive footage and survivor testimonies chronicle the 2012 sinking of a luxury cruise ship and its aftermath.

metas.name: The Crash
metas.description: Follows the Mackenzie Shirilla case, a 17-year-old who intentionally crashed her car into a brick wall in Ohio, killing her boyfriend Dominic Russo and his friend Davion Flanagan.

metas.name: Untold UK: Jamie Vardy
metas.description: Jamie Vardy's evolution from part time football player to a Premier League legend.

metas.name: Marty, Life Is Short
metas.description: Follows the definitive documentary on comedian Martin Short, exploring his career across film, television, theater and comedy.

metas.name: Iron Maiden: Burning Ambition
metas.description: Spanning five decades, Iron Maiden: Burning Ambition charts their iconic rise to become one of the biggest bands in music history.

metas.name: Billie Eilish: Hit Me Hard and Soft - The Tour Live in 3D
metas.description: An accompanying 3D concert film, documenting the Manchester shows and co-directed by Eilish and James Cameron.

metas.name: A Gorilla Story: Told by David Attenborough
metas.description: David Attenborough tells the remarkable story of his first encounter with the baby gorilla Pablo, how that gorilla grew up to be a top Silverback and how Pablo's direct descendants are doing today.

metas.name: S4: The Bob Lazar Story
metas.description: From jet engines to Los Alamos, Bob Lazar's life is rooted in science. In 1988, hired at S4 near Area 51, he reverse-engineered alien tech. Narrated by Lazar, this film uses exclusive footage to reveal America's best-kept secret.

metas.name: The Rise of the Red Hot Chili Peppers
metas.description: Gritty, formative years of the Los Angeles band, and the influence of original guitarist Hillel Slovak, who died in 1988. It features interviews with bandmates Flea and Anthony Kiedis who discuss the band's early evolution.

metas.name: Louis Theroux: Inside the Manosphere
metas.description: The acclaimed documentarian gains rare, unrestricted access to explore a rising ultra-masculine network and its polarizing influencers.

metas.name: Man on the Run
metas.description: An intimate portrait of Paul McCartney's trajectory after The Beatles, as he and his wife Linda form Wings.

metas.name: EPiC: Elvis Presley in Concert
metas.description: Follows Elvis Presley, featuring never-before-seen footage and recordings.

metas.name: The Investigation of Lucy Letby
metas.description: Unseen footage and unheard insider accounts reveal the harrowing and divisive Case of Lucy Letby, the neonatal nurse convicted of fatally harming infants.

metas.name: Queen of Chess
metas.description: Hungarian chess prodigy Judit Polgár challenges champion Garry Kasparov and her controlling father over 15 years, breaking gender barriers to become the greatest female player ever and one of history's finest.

metas.name: Cover-Up
metas.description: Seymour Hersh has been at the front lines of political journalism in the United States. Hersh's breakthrough reportage has brought to the public's attention many of the most damning constitutional wrongdoings and cover-ups.

metas.name: Dave Chappelle: The Unstoppable
metas.description: Facing a world gone sideways, comedy icon Dave Chappelle delivers bold truths and potent punchlines in this no-holds-barred special.

metas.name: Breakdown: 1975
metas.description: In 1975, as America faced social and political upheaval, filmmakers turned chaos into art.

metas.name: Murder in Monaco
metas.description: Monaco, 1999: Billionaire banker Edmond Safra is found dead in his penthouse. The documentary examines the puzzling circumstances surrounding this wealthy financier's murder.

metas.name: The Age of Disclosure
metas.description: Featuring 34 U.S. Government insiders, this explosive documentary reveals an 80-year global cover-up of non-human intelligent life and a secret war among major nations to reverse engineer advanced technology of non-human origin.

metas.name: The Carman Family Deaths
metas.description: A fishing trip ends in tragedy when Linda Carman vanishes at sea leaving her son Nathan adrift for days. His rescue stirs up questions about his grandfather's murder and ignites a battle over inheritance that leads to shocking rev...

metas.name: Come See Me in the Good Light
metas.description: In an intimate and joyful story of love in the face of loss, celebrated poets Andrea Gibson and Megan Falley find strength—and unexpected hilarity—in what might be their final year together.

metas.name: Being Eddie
metas.description: Follows a comprehensive look at Eddie Murphy's life and career.

metas.name: Aileen: Queen of the Serial Killers
metas.description: Aileen Wuornos killed 7 men while working as a prostitute in Florida (1989-90), claiming self-defense against rape.

metas.name: The Perfect Neighbor
metas.description: A minor disagreement between neighbors in Florida takes a lethal turn, with police body camera footage and interviews probing the aftermath of the state's controversial "stand your ground" laws.

metas.name: My Father, the BTK Killer
metas.description: Family man and Scout leader Dennis Rader led a double life as BTK killer. His daughter Kerri Rawson shares her experience with her father's horrific crimes.

metas.name: John Candy: I Like Me
metas.description: Explores the life and legacy of iconic funnyman John Candy, who died of a heart attack in 1994, at age 43.

metas.name: All the Empty Rooms
metas.description: A journalist and a photographer set out to memorialize the bedrooms left behind by children killed in school shootings.

metas.name: Unknown Number: The High School Catfish
metas.description: A teen girl and her boyfriend face persistent harassment from an unknown caller. Police investigating the months of torment discover a revelation that upends their initial assumptions.

metas.name: It's Never Over, Jeff Buckley
metas.description: Rising musician Jeff Buckley had only released one album when he died suddenly in 1997. Now, never-before-seen footage, exclusive voice messages, and accounts from those closest to him offer a portrait of the captivating singer.

metas.name: Stolen: Heist of the Century
metas.description: In 2003, elite thieves dubbed 'The School of Turin' pulled off a historic heist at a supposedly unbreakable vault in Antwerp's diamond district, making off with hundreds of millions in gems that remain missing today.
